request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Patrons and backing are working, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What a person sees on their row**
- A dropdown listing everyone else on the sheet (not the person themselves) and an "Add patron" button.
- Their patrons' names, sorted and separated by ", ".
- Their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a. It shows 0.00 when they have no patrons.

**What happens on add**
- The server refuses the person themselves, someone not on the sheet, or a patron they already have. It saves nothing and writes no audit line, and the row shows `person-patron-error`. The error goes away when the dropdown changes or the button is pressed again.
- An add that goes through writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=… by=… name=<name> patron=<patron name>` to the audit file.

**How it's built**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V18__patron.sql`, adds a `patron` table. Its primary key stops the same patron being added twice, even when two users add them at once.
- **Server:** a new `patron` package with two endpoints. `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/patrons` adds a patron. `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/patrons` lists them.
- **Front end:** a new `features/patrons/` slot on the person row. Backing is worked out in the browser from the same due-total calculation the due-total column already uses (`personDue`), so the two always agree. Patrons are cached under the sheet's data, so re-loading the sheet picks up another user's changes.

Two behaviours the request didn't specify:
- A patron's name still counts after they are retired.
- Pressing "Add patron" with nothing chosen shows the error.
